note: Template for a prop from an outside picture (docs/art/PROP_FROM_REF.md). Put the crop under .scratch/outside/ (ignored by git), fill seen from looking at it, get it confirmed, decide the palette, then: pnpm kit:gen tools/kit-gen/example-outside.json --out .scratch/kit-gen/example --dry, read the prompt, then the real call. ramps names the shared ramps of palette v2 the sprite draws in (tools/src/kit/palette.ts); with palette fits or restyle leave ramps out and the 32 core colours are the whole set. Drop style and style_refs for the kit's flat two-tone line (no dither). Nothing goes into content/.

entries.name: signpost_example
entries.what: wooden signpost holding a small framed painting
entries.seen: a wooden post with a small framed picture mounted on it, seen from the front: a dark brown post, a light wooden frame around a tiny landscape painting in greens and blues, a small plank roof above the frame, lit from the upper left; the rectangle carries grass and red leaves behind it
entries.detail: the post in three browns with grain, the frame lighter with a lit edge, the painting as a tiny landscape in four or five greens and blues, the plank roof with a shadow under it, no leaves behind
